name: Italian Sausage, Tomato & Mushroom Bake with Sautéed Cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions into thin half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Quarter mushrooms; add to the bowl with the onion and garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add flour to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes more.
Add tomatoes, broth, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine, then bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once simmering, transfer veggie skillet to a large baking dish; nestle sausages into the veggies. Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping sausages once, until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
Wipe reserved skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cabbage and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Once the cabbage is done, add pine nuts and parsley to the skillet; stir to combine. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
To serve, divide veggie bake and sautéed cabbage between plates or bowls; top with sausages and enjoy!
